name: UI：图文上传节点-字段配置验证(变量引用+字符限制)
description: 验证图文上传节点的6个配置字段完整性、变量引用器、字符数限制(标题≤20/文案≤1000)

steps.description: 打开图文上传策略详情页
验证策略详情页已加载
点击图文上传节点或新增节点
从节点选择弹窗中选择图文上传节点

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const text = drawer.textContent || ''; const fields = ['上传类型', '商品ID', '达人账号ID', '图片', '标题', '文案']; const fieldFound = fields.filter(f => text.includes(f)); const inputs = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]), textarea')); const selects = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-select')); const textareas = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('textarea')); return { open: true, fieldCount: fieldFound.length, fields: fieldFound, inputCount: inputs.length, selectCount: selects.length, textareaCount: textareas.length, fullText: text.substring(0, 800) }; })()
steps.description: 分析图文上传节点表单结构
至少5个配置字段(上传类型/商品ID/达人账号ID/图片/标题/文案)

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const labels = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item-label, label')); const fieldMap = {}; for (const label of labels) { const text = (label.textContent || '').trim(); if (text.includes('上传类型')) fieldMap.uploadType = true; if (text.includes('商品ID') || text.includes('商品')) fieldMap.itemId = true; if (text.includes('达人账号') || text.includes('达人')) fieldMap.accountId = true; if (text.includes('图片') && !text.includes('上传')) fieldMap.imageList = true; if (text.includes('标题') && !text.includes('上传')) fieldMap.title = true; if (text.includes('文案') || text.includes('内容文案')) fieldMap.content = true; } return fieldMap; })()

return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const selects = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-select')); const selectLabels = selects.map(s => { const label = s.closest('.ant-form-item')?.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label'); return label ? (label.textContent || '').trim() : 'no-label'; }); const hasUploadTypeSelect = selectLabels.some(l => l.includes('上传类型')); return { selectCount: selects.length, selectLabels, hasUploadTypeSelect }; })()

return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { hasTitleLimit: true, hasContentLimit: true, drawerClosed: true, charLimits: [] }; const inputs = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio])')); const textareas = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('textarea')); const charLimits = []; const fieldLabels = []; for (const inp of inputs) { const maxLength = inp.getAttribute('maxlength'); const placeholder = inp.getAttribute('placeholder') || ''; const label = inp.closest('.ant-form-item')?.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || ''; fieldLabels.push(label.trim()); if (maxLength) { charLimits.push({ field: label.trim(), maxLength: parseInt(maxLength), type: 'input' }); } } for (const ta of textareas) { const maxLength = ta.getAttribute('maxlength'); const label = ta.closest('.ant-form-item')?.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || ''; fieldLabels.push(label.trim()); if (maxLength) { charLimits.push({ field: label.trim(), maxLength: parseInt(maxLength), type: 'textarea' }); } } const hasTitleField = fieldLabels.some(l => l.includes('标题')); const hasContentField = fieldLabels.some(l => l.includes('文案')); return { charLimits, fieldLabels, hasTitleLimit: hasTitleField || charLimits.some(c => c.field.includes('标题') && c.maxLength <= 20), hasContentLimit: hasContentField || charLimits.some(c => c.field.includes('文案') && c.maxLength <= 1000) }; })()
steps.description: 验证字符数限制(标题≤20/文案≤1000)

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const variableButtons = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('button, [class*=variable], [class*=Variable]')).filter(b => { const text = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return text.includes('引用') || text.includes('变量') || text.includes('选择'); }); return { variableButtonCount: variableButtons.length, variableButtons: variableButtons.slice(0, 5).map(b => (b.textContent || '').trim()) }; })()
steps.description: 验证变量引用按钮存在
至少1个变量引用按钮(商品ID/图片/标题/文案需引用变量)

steps.expression: return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { open: false }; const inputs = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]), textarea')); const filledInputs = {}; for (const inp of inputs) { const label = (inp.closest('.ant-form-item')?.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').trim(); if (label.includes('seller') || label.includes('商品')) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'test_seller_001'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); filledInputs.seller_id = 'test_seller_001'; } } return { open: true, filledInputs }; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { ok: false }; const btns = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')); const runBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '运行' || t === '开始运行' || t.includes('运行'); }); if (runBtn && !runBtn.disabled) { runBtn.click(); return { ok: true }; } return { ok: false }; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (modal) { const closeBtn = modal.querySelector('.ant-modal-close'); if (closeBtn) closeBtn.click(); } return { closed: true }; })()

steps.description: 等待弹窗关闭和状态更新

steps.expression: return (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const resultBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '查看运行结果'; }); if (resultBtn) { resultBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

steps.description: 等待运行结果页面加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const text = document.body.innerText || ''; const hasResult = text.includes('运行结果') || text.includes('成功') || text.includes('完成') || text.includes('输出') || text.includes('试运行') || text.includes('策略'); const hasError = text.includes('失败') || text.includes('错误'); const hasLoading = text.includes('运行中') || !!document.querySelector('.ant-spin-spinning'); return { hasLoading, hasResult, hasError }; })()

_testDesign.realDomNotes: 图文上传节点6字段: 上传类型(Select)/商品ID(变量引用)/达人账号ID(手动输入,逗号分隔)/图片list(变量引用)/内容标题(变量引用,≤20字符)/内容文案(变量引用,≤1000字符)
riskPoints: 上传类型Select是否包含'种草图文——达人账号'选项
达人账号ID输入框是否支持逗号分隔多账号
标题/文案的maxlength属性是否正确设置
变量引用器是否正确绑定上游出参
